510801.name: Poison Laser
510801.description: Fires a laser beam from its neck, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit is afflicted with Toxic Substance Status and takes sustained damage, which can stack.

510802.name: Laser Machine Gun
510802.description: Fires a barrage of laser beams from its neck, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510803.name: Poison Bubble Missile
510803.description: Fires a barrage of poison bubble missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit is afflicted with Poison Bubble Status and takes sustained damage, which can stack. The missiles can be intercepted.

510804.name: Eye Laser
510804.description: Fires laser beams from its eyes, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510805.name: Poison Breath
510805.description: Spews poisonous gas from its mouth, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Deals enhanced sustained damage to any Nikke who is hit based on the number of Poison Bubble stacks applied.

510806.name: Body Strike
510806.description: Strikes with its body, dealing damage to all Nikkes. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.

510807.name: Poison Gas
510807.description:
Spews poisonous gas from its entire body, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Deals enhanced sustained damage to any Nikke who is hit based on the number of Toxic Substance stacks applied.
Black Snake generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while accumulating Poison Gas. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.
